name: tscaps
creator: francozanardi
category: Subtitles, transcription, dialogue cleanup, and automatic editing
description: Browser video and subtitle editor with local Whisper transcription, animated captions, b-roll, graphics, transitions, audio and optional MCP/agent editing. Exports subtitles and rendered media for Resolve; it does not create editable Fusion captions. Web app 0.7.0 and engine 0.8 are separate versions.
display_description: Browser video and subtitle editor with local Whisper transcription, animated captions, b-roll, graphics, transitions, audio and optional MCP/agent editing. Exports subtitles and rendered media for Resolve; it does not create editable Fusion captions. Web app 0.7.0 and engine 0.8 are separate versions.
platform_notes: Requires a supported WebCodecs browser. Editor is AGPL-3.0; engine/templates MIT. First use downloads transcription models.
